name: intent-engineering
description: Intent controller, eight composable operators, three codebase-design skills, and five executable ratchets for evidence-driven reliable software work.

interface.shortDescription: Run intent-driven work through the smallest sufficient evidence-backed loop
interface.longDescription: A controller and eight composable operators for moving from intent to evidence-backed change, codebase-design skills for obvious/local contribution paths, and executable ratchets that convert validated engineering lessons into repository-owned constraints.
defaultPrompt: Take this through the smallest sufficient intent-engineering loop.
Use $intent on this task and keep progress evidence-backed.
Verify and validate this change, then capture any durable learning.
Learn from this failure and ratchet the repository so the same class of mistake is harder to repeat.
Design where this change should live, predict its blast radius, and make the supported path obvious before implementing it.
